subject: Business Resilience: RPO/RTO attestation and SIG-BCP follow-up
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finledger.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@finledger.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: SIG: BCP/DR details + RTO/RPO numbers request

Hi Jordan / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of FinLedger's vendor assessment for our platform availability controls, our security team has a few asks to close the SIG and CAIQ coverage items for Business Continuity / Disaster Recovery:

- Per-region RTO and RPO targets (prod us-east-1, prod eu-west-1) with evidence of recent execution
- High-level DR runbook (ownership, failover steps, rollback criteria)
- Evidence that an actual DR test was executed in the last 12 months (summary, date, results)
- A signed attestation we can retain for our audit files

I've attached the SIG questionnaire (FinLedger_SIG_v3.pdf) and highlighted the BCP section. Can you confirm you can provide these by EOD Nov 10? If you need more time, let me know the earliest you can commit to.

Thanks,
Raj
Raj Patel
Sr. Risk Manager, FinLedger
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finledger.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-09T11:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: SIG: BCP/DR details + RTO/RPO numbers request

Hi Raj — appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide per-region RTO/RPO numbers, our DR runbook excerpt, and a signed attestation. Attaching the draft attestation and a short RTO/RPO summary for review (RI_RPO_RTO_Attestation_20261109.pdf).

Notes:
- Production per-region targets: us-east-1 RTO = 30 minutes (automatic fallback to warm standby), RPO = 5 minutes; eu-west-1 RTO = 45 minutes, RPO = 15 minutes.
- We ran a full failover drill on 2026-07-28 for the US region and a tabletop exercise for EU on 2026-05-14. Summary screenshots attached (DR_test_summary_Q32026.png).
- Runbook excerpt: failover coordination is owned by Site Reliability (Marissa), with Product Ops as the escalation path. I included a link to our shared drive with the sanitized runbook and test logs.

We want to make sure any attestation language satisfies FinLedger's audit team — happy to jump on a 20-min call if you want to walk the attestation piece live.

Attachment(s): RI_RPO_RTO_Attestation_20261109.pdf, DR_test_summary_Q32026.png

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finledger.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-09T13:22:00-05:00
Subject: Re: SIG: BCP/DR details + RTO/RPO numbers request

Raj — thanks for the note. Quick clarifications from the runbook side: 

- Runbook owner: Marissa Cole, Director of Site Reliability (marissa_cole@redwood.ai).
- Failover steps (high-level): 1) Verify ongoing write KVs and persist KV cache snapshot; 2) Spin up standby pool in target region; 3) Promote replica; 4) Validate token-level latency and run smoke prompts; 5) Notify customers and update routing.
- Rollback criteria: if token latency > 2x SLO after 10 minutes or 10% of requests error for 3 consecutive minutes, revert to previous configuration and open incident post-mortem.

I can export a sanitized PDF of the runbook (removing internal IPs/keys) and send it by EOD. Also, Vivek — can you confirm that procurement / contracting will accept the standard attestation (no further SOW required)?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Site Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finledger.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-10T08:17:00-05:00
Subject: Re: SIG: BCP/DR details + RTO/RPO numbers request

Thanks Marissa and Jordan — this helps. Two quick follow-ups:
1) FinLedger's audit team asks for per-region signed attestation (we store a signed PDF). Is that something Redwood Legal can sign, or do you provide an exec-signed statement?
2) We need evidence that the US failover drill executed end-to-end (screenshots alone are ok, but a short test log or runbook checklist is preferred).

Deadline: we can accept these by COB Nov 12 if more time is needed, but Nov 10 would be ideal.

If we can get the signed attestation, runbook excerpt, and the drill checklist by Nov 12, we'll be able to close BCP items in the SIG.

Regards,
Raj
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
